Why CHANGAN

Three
reasons

What sits underneath every Deepal: the design thinking, the connected technology and the battery system.

01 / 03Design

Our eco-aesthetic aspect

CHANGAN builds cutting-edge EVs because we believe our customers deserve more than a low-carbon car. They are entitled to eco-friendly innovation that matches their style as much as it complements their lifestyle.

02 / 03Technology

Our future-today technology

CHANGAN has invested in the most advanced technology for today’s life-changing innovations, and was the first company to put the intelligent human-vehicle into mass production — cloud-based interconnection that links people, vehicle and living space.

03 / 03Energy

Our energy-efficiency battery

Our Battery Management System (BMS) smartly maximises battery efficiency across electric storage, motor support and in-car power supply — raising the benchmark for EVs and extending battery life.

Technology — Golden Shield

Golden Shield Battery

Protection and management are built into the pack. The BMS balances storage, motor support and in-car power supply, so the battery works harder and lasts longer.
